definitions.gloss: hit rate; accuracy rate; percentage of hits
definitions.explanation: The proportion of shots or attempts that hit a target, expressed as a rate or percentage. Used for shooting, missiles, and ball sports.

examples.japanese: {命中率|めいちゅうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦シュート→シュート：05926_shuuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命中率|めいちゅうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This player has good shooting accuracy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧、⟦フリー→フリー：11001_furii⟧⟦スロー→スロー：33118_suroo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命中率|めいちゅうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: With steady practice, my free-throw percentage went up.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{命中|めいちゅう}→命中：18487_meichuu⟧ (hitting the mark) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate, ratio).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命中率|めいちゅうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have a high hit rate
- {命中率|めいちゅうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise accuracy
- {命中率|めいちゅうりつ}⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧: a 100% hit rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {的中率|てきちゅうりつ}: rate of correct predictions — the word for forecasts, guesses, and bets; a prediction method is judged by its {的中率|てきちゅうりつ}, not its {命中率|めいちゅうりつ}
- {成功率|せいこうりつ}: success rate — broader; any kind of success, not just hitting a target
